column3: Jazan Refinery & Terminal (Jizan, Red Sea coast)
column15: Aramco SHUT the 400 kb/d Jazan refinery 7/27 after a Houthi strike; damage to the IGCC complex and tank-farm area; restart tentatively 2026-08-15 (~19d). ⚠️ SOURCE-TIER A-2 NOT A-1 AND THE REASON MATTERS: Reuters is relaying a consultancy note (IIR) - Aramco itself has issued NO statement and did not reply to Reuters. Satellite BDA (bashareport) puts damage in one-or-two of three liquid-hydrocarbon tank farms on the eastern side with NO clear evidence that crude distillation, hydrocracking, hydrotreating or hydrogen units were directly hit => consistent with a PRECAUTIONARY shutdown of a largely intact plant, which is why an 8/15 restart reads credible rather than optimistic. THESIS SIGNIFICANCE: this is the first REFINED-PRODUCT supply loss of the war and it is crude-BEARISH / product-bullish - shutting a refinery FREES its feedstock for export. It is the Gulf leg of the v5.2 molecule split. Watch 8/15: a slip, or an extension reaching CRUDE operations, is the tell that moves this from product to crude. [FALCON packet 7/30; Reuters/IIR 7/28]

column3: CPC Marine Terminal - SPM-3 (Yuzhnaya Ozereyevka, Novorossiysk) - RE-HALT
column15: SIXTH strike on CPC, and a RE-HALT three days after the 7/27 resumption. 2026-07-30 01:48 Moscow: NISSOS SIFNOS (Marshall Is., TENGIZCHEVROIL/CHEVRON cargo) hit by UAV near the crude-receiving manifolds WHILE LOADING AT SPM-3, cargo-deck fire extinguished with three CPC support vessels; MARATHI (Isle of Man) attacked ~6 nm out awaiting berth. OPERATOR PRIMARY (A-1, gold standard): CPC states 'Oil loading has been stopped, while pipeline facilities are operating normally.' No casualties, no spill. Logged separately from RF-038 rather than folded into it, because the discriminating fact is RECURRENCE. CORRECTED SEQUENCE (my prior record was incomplete): attack 7/19 -> resumed 7/19 eve -> halted 7/20 -> resumed 7/27 -> attacked+halted 7/30. ★ WHY IT RE-MARKED MY CONVERGENCE ROW 2->3: per-event reversibility still holds (nothing destroyed, pipeline normal) but recurrence is information reversibility does not capture - 'it restores on a decision' stops being reassuring when the decision must be re-made six times. That is a chronic tax, not a blip. bpd_offline blank pending a published figure for THIS halt; system ~1.58 mb/d, Kazakh output fell to ~1.0 mb/d (7/26) vs a 2.16 mb/d June average during the prior halt.
